none: PAS GLO-1FF8D4: Penny of Edward the Confessor
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ EADPARD REX A ; R/ LEOFPINE ON GLE

An early medieval silver penny of Edward the Confessor (1042-66). Type: Pyramids (North 831). Date 1065-1066. Diameter 18mm, weight 1.25g. Obverse: Bust facing right, bearded and crowned: in front, a sceptre. Obverse inscription: EADPARD REX A. Reverse: short cross voided, in each angle a pyramid springing from an inner circle and terminating in a pellet. Reverse inscription: LEOFPINE ON GLE.…
